profile_text.body:
Shopify Inc. is a publicly traded company headquartered in Ottawa, listed under the ticker SHOP and registered with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission under CIK 0001594805. Its shares also appear under the name SHOPIFY INC - CLASS A.

On its own website, Shopify describes itself as an all-in-one commerce platform for businesses. It invites businesses to try the platform free and says they can build or grow quickly with AI, positioning the offering as more than ecommerce software by including tools to manage every part of a business. The site also describes features for reaching shoppers across AI channels, with checkout completed inside a chat and no manual steps required, which it attributes to Agentic Storefronts.

The material available does not detail specific product lines, pricing, or customers beyond those claims.
